jobs.description: Fellowship in Paintings Conservation SRAL is offering a fellowship (full-time, 40h) in the Paintings Conservation Department. The one-year fellowship will commence on May 1st, 2027 and include a monthly stipend of €2850,- gross. SRAL Fellowship in Paintings Conservation Working under the guidance of the SRAL conservators the fellow will focus on practical conservation and restoration treatments as well as on a research project. The fellow will work as part of the team and participate in the daily activities of the conservation studio, focusing on easel paintings on canvas and possibly panel. Also, they may have the opportunity to join conservation work on site. The intern will carry out a range of conservation treatments including technical examination, photographic as well as written documentation. They also will be encouraged to participate in the decision-making processes. Participation in workshops, lectures and occasional studio visits will contribute to the fellowship programme. Although the research project's initial outline will be provided by SRAL conservators, its ultimate direction and scope will be decided in close consultation with the fellow. Eligibility Applicants hold a master's degree in conservation. They should have a maximum of two years of professional experience post-graduation. Alongside proficiency in English a demonstrated aptitude for research and writing is an advantage. The position is open to candidates of all nationalities. Candidates are responsible for securing visas and other permits for their stay and work in the Netherlands. (SRAL is not a registered sponsor at IND).
